researchTopic: How can the Skilled test cycle get faster after the five cuts already built? Measured state on an 18-core Mac: the system-deep-loop suite takes 504-511 s (161 files in parallel, then 12 timing-sensitive files serially, about 265 s: tests/stress/**, tests/lifecycle/**, unit/fanout-run, unit/lineage-timestamp-window, integration/deep-research-postflip-fanout). The system-spec-kit npm test takes 841-911 s: the core lane 348-399 s (about 300 s of it is import time), the cli lane about 400 s set by tests/upgrade-legacy.vitest.ts alone, and validation about 90 s. Open items: (1) the cli lane's upgrade-legacy file sets its time; (2) the 12 serial deep-loop files; (3) the 300 s import time in the spec-kit core lane; (4) ledger read caching ideas in production code (singleWriterReadCache, gateway rescans) that change runtime behavior; (5) a smaller CI runner gains less from parallel files. Prioritize changes that keep every assertion, measure before claiming and avoid overengineering.
